picks.name: Zoom Janoski OG+ Premium, tan suede
picks.why: Black Friday-list Janoski at a third off (£59.95, was £89.95) with UK 10 in stock: a fourth trainer and the first in a warm suede rather than black or white. Low-profile skate classic in two-tone tan and brown with a small tick; wear it with the 502s, a grey marl sweat and the brown overshirt.

picks.name: 3001 Overshirt, brown
picks.why: No overshirts owned yet, and everyday, travel and date-night looks all want one. Same 3001 cut as the army green on the watch list, in a warm brown organic cotton at half price (£42.50, was £85), plain with a small woven label. Wear it open over a tee with the 502s and Sambas, or under the waxed jacket.

picks.name: Fisherman Raglan Jumper, Heavy Cotton, Navy
picks.why: Knits are still the biggest gap with none owned, and office, date and outdoor outfits all lean on one. A heavy 100% cotton rib crew, regular fit with raglan sleeves rather than a dropped shoulder, no branding, 40% off (£90, was £150). Last L left. Wear it over a tee with the fawn chinos, or with the 502s under the field jacket.
